headlines.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Admits Affair With Suspected Chinese Spy
headlines.summary: Listen up — this is the kind of headline that stops the tape cold. Nvidia's board launching an independent probe into Jensen Huang over a suspected Chinese intelligence connection hits the stock with a governance crisis, a national security angle, AND a succession question all at once. The whole AI trade — NVDA, CoreWeave, the hyperscalers — takes collateral damage when the face of the chip boom is under a spy investigation.

headlines.title: Oil Extends Drop as Hopes Grow of Diplomatic Progress to End War
headlines.summary: Oil posting its biggest weekly drop since April 2020 is a macro event that ripples across every sector — lower energy costs are a tailwind for airlines, industrials, and consumers, while E&P names get hit. The Strait of Hormuz situation is still live with navigation aids destroyed and fresh shipping attacks, so this relief rally in equities could reverse fast if diplomacy stalls — Rubio's already calling Iranian demands 'outrageous.'

headlines.title: CoreWeave confronts 'doom cycle' narrative as neocloud credit risk overshadows growth
headlines.summary: CoreWeave and Nebius are both down roughly 50% in a month heading into earnings — that's not a dip, that's a rout, and the 'doom cycle' framing around neocloud credit risk could spread contagion to the broader AI infrastructure trade. With the CNBC investing club flagging CoreWeave earnings as one of the two big things to watch this week, this is a live catalyst that could either stabilize or accelerate the AI selloff.
